title: Suppliers
description: Who runs, backs up, patches and recovers the systems and solutions you use – with contracts, notice dates, SLAs and certificates.
noMatch: No supplier matches the search and filters.
emptyText: Add the SaaS providers, managed platforms, software vendors and service providers your services depend on. Applications, systems, ticket references, page watches, cost plan lines and duties can then link them.
toConfirmEmpty: Nothing to confirm. Free-text vendors from before 0.17 are all handled.
toConfirmIntro: On the update to 0.17, each distinct vendor text became a supplier waiting for confirmation, with its spellings. Confirm a real supplier, merge duplicates into one, or mark a text that names no supplier (an account name, “On-premises”) as not a supplier: its links are cleared and the text stays.

fields.name: Name
fields.ownersHelp: Get the supplier's reminders and may change it. Unlike the owning teams, they do not limit who sees it – someone named from outside those teams can see it too.
fields.personalData: Processes personal data for our services
fields.docLinkHint: An http(s) link, or the number of a document in Steward (e.g. DOC-2026-0004).
fields.criticalityHint: The highest protection need of the linked applications.

detail.unconfirmedNote: This supplier was made from free-text vendors on the update to 0.17. Confirm it, merge it into another supplier, or mark it as not a supplier.
detail.archivedNote: Archived: kept for its history and the items that still link it, not offered in forms.
detail.dataProtectionDefaultHint: Contracts that answer “as the supplier” use this; each contract can answer for itself.
detail.dpaMissingContracts_one: {{count}} contract processes personal data without a data processing agreement.
detail.dpaMissingContracts_other: {{count}} contracts process personal data without a data processing agreement.

confirmNotSupplier: Mark “{{name}}” as not a supplier? The supplier goes and the items that link it keep their text. The text is not made a supplier again.
confirmArchive: Archive “{{name}}”? It stays linked where it is and is no longer offered in forms.

merge.title: Merge “{{name}}” into another supplier
merge.intro: Its links, contacts, contracts, certificates and spellings move to the supplier you choose, and “{{name}}” goes. The other supplier keeps its name, type and who is responsible.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.help: People at the supplier. Their e-mail and phone stay in the app: the API, MCP, datasets and exports leave them out.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.removeConfirm: Remove the contact “{{name}}”? It is deleted.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.help: Term, notice period and renewal give the notice-by date: the last day to give notice. The owners are reminded 90 and 30 days before it.
contracts.removeConfirm: Remove the contract “{{name}}”? Cost plan lines that name it keep the supplier.
contracts.removeWithPayments_one: Remove the contract “{{name}}”? Its payment schedules go – paid by {{services}}; plan lines made from them stay as ordinary lines.
contracts.removeWithPayments_other: Remove the contract “{{name}}”? Its payment schedules go – paid by {{services}}; plan lines made from them stay as ordinary lines.

certificates.title: Certificates and reports
certificates.help: Those responsible for the supplier and the owners of its contracts are reminded 90 and 30 days before a certificate runs out. A SOC 2 report is valid for twelve months after the end of its period unless you enter another date.
certificates.name: Name
certificates.issuedOn: Issued (a SOC 2 report: end of its period)
certificates.validUntilHint: Empty for a SOC 2 report: the end of its period plus twelve months.
certificates.link: Certificate or report (URL or document number)

usedBy.title: Used by
usedBy.empty: Nothing links this supplier yet. Choose it in the form of an application, system, ticket reference, page watch, cost plan line or duty, in the responsibilities of a service, in a row of the statement of applicability or in a corrective action finding.

duties.title: Supplier review
duties.help: A duty of a service that names this supplier, for example with the example process “Supplier review”.
duties.empty: No duty reviews this supplier yet.

picker.label: Supplier
picker.hint: The supplier record; without one, the text below is kept.
picker.contractHint: The supplier's contract this line pays for.

contractsTab.help: Each team holds its own contracts: a contract with a team among its owners is seen only by its owners, the readers of the services it covers, administrators and auditors.

servicesTab.help: The services covered by the contracts you may see, with their purposes – and those that use the supplier through applications or systems without a contract.
servicesTab.empty: No service you may see uses this supplier.

contract.noReviews: No supplier review or finding names this contract.
contract.visibleOpen: No team is among its owners: everyone who may see the supplier sees this contract.
contract.visibleTeam: Seen by the members of {{teams}}, its user owners, the readers of the services it covers, administrators and auditors.

why.supplierReaders: You see it because you see the supplier.
why.admin: You see it as an administrator.
why.auditor: You see it as an auditor.
why.owner: You see it as one of its owners.
why.service: You see it because you see a service it covers.
why.platform: You see it because you manage a platform it covers.

contract.hiddenMaster: Part of a master agreement you may not see.
contract.hidden: A contract you may not see
contract.removeMaster_one: This master agreement has {{count}} order form. It becomes standalone, with the values it inherited copied into it. Remove the master agreement?
contract.removeMaster_other: This master agreement has {{count}} order forms. They become standalone, with the values they inherited copied into them. Remove the master agreement?
contract.replacedByHint: Optional: another contract of this supplier that you may change takes over its services, payment schedules, plan lines, entries, matrix rows, duties, findings and contacts.
contract.visiblePlatforms: Also seen by the managers and owning teams of: {{platforms}}

contractForm.servicesHint: The services the contract covers – you may add a contract for a service you edit. The purpose can be added on the contract.
contractForm.masterHint: Optional: the master agreement this order form belongs to (one level).
contractForm.ownersHint: Users and teams who manage the contract and get its notice reminders.
contractForm.ownersNewHint: Empty: you and your teams for new resources.
contractForm.opens: No team is among the owners any more: everyone who may see the supplier will see this contract.
contractForm.inheritHint: Empty values are taken from the master agreement (shown in grey).
contractForm.personalData: Processes personal data for the services it covers
contractForm.dpaInherited: As the master agreement or supplier
contractForm.platformsHint: Optional: a platform team's own contract (capacity, a cloud spend commitment). Their managers and owning teams see it.

contractServices.dismissConfirm: The contract does not cover “{{service}}”? Plan lines and matrix rows that name it stay as they are.
contractServices.leaveConfirm: Take “{{service}}” off the contract “{{contract}}”? Plan lines and matrix rows that name the contract keep it.
contractServices.hidden_one: and {{count}} service you may not see
contractServices.hidden_other: and {{count}} services you may not see
contractServices.itemsHint: Optional: what of the service the contract is for. None: the service as a whole.

scopedContacts.hiddenItems_one: and {{count}} item you may not see
scopedContacts.hiddenItems_other: and {{count}} items you may not see
scopedContacts.scopeHint: Empty: company-wide. A scoped contact is seen only by who may see one of its items.
scopedContacts.scopedHint: A scoped contact never becomes company-wide: remove the contact instead of its last item.
scopedContacts.lastItem: Remove the contact instead of its last item.

serviceSuppliers.title: Suppliers
serviceSuppliers.empty: No contract covers this service yet.
serviceSuppliers.newSupplierHint: The new contract covers this service.
serviceSuppliers.uncovered: Suppliers its applications and systems use, without a contract covering the service
serviceSuppliers.leaveConfirm: Take this service off the contract “{{contract}}”?
serviceSuppliers.dismissConfirm: The contract “{{contract}}” does not cover this service?

shared.title: Same supplier in several teams
shared.intro: Suppliers that look like one company, kept apart by team since the update to 0.17. Merging them into one shared supplier keeps each team’s contracts and contacts protected.
shared.widens: This merge shows the company record to more people.
shared.gainers: Gain sight of the company record (name, certificates, company-wide contacts): {{names}}
shared.narrows: This merge hides a supplier, and the contracts on it, from people who see it now.
shared.losers: Lose sight of the supplier and its contracts (notice-by reminders of contracts nobody can see any more go to the administrators): {{names}}
shared.openTitle: Change the owning teams of the supplier
shared.openIntro: Nothing changes before you confirm. Contracts and contacts stay with who sees them now: contracts without a team owner get the supplier's teams as owners, company-wide contacts are scoped to its contracts.
shared.certificatesCombined_one: {{count}} certificate is the same as one of the shared supplier: combined.
shared.certificatesCombined_other: {{count}} certificates are the same as ones of the shared supplier: combined.
shared.dpaWritten: Personal data and DPA written onto: {{contracts}}
shared.moves: Also moves: links, {{spellings}} spellings, {{schedules}} payment schedules.
shared.noticeTitle: Contracts now seen only by their owners and services
shared.noticeText_one: Since the update, contracts have owners of their own. {{count}} contract whose supplier had a team among its owners is now seen only by its owners, the readers of the services it covers, administrators and auditors. Removing the team owner reopens it.
shared.noticeText_other: Since the update, contracts have owners of their own. {{count}} contracts whose supplier had a team among its owners are now seen only by their owners, the readers of the services they cover, administrators and auditors. Removing the team owner reopens a contract.
shared.proposedIntro: The update to 0.18 proposed these services from the plan lines, cost entries and matrix rows that name the contracts. Confirm each one, or choose “Not this service”.

contractPlatforms.hidden_one: and {{count}} platform you may not see
contractPlatforms.hidden_other: and {{count}} platforms you may not see
contractPlatforms.addHint: A platform team's own contract. Its managers and the members of its owning teams then see a team-owned contract.

platformContracts.title: Contracts
platformContracts.help: The contracts covering this platform – the platform team's own. Add payments to plan them; a contract's costs are never split among the services that use the platform.
platformContracts.empty: No contract covers this platform yet.
platformContracts.leaveConfirm: Take this platform off the contract “{{contract}}”?
